notes.title: Kuroinu Redux | New Visual Novel
notes.content:
[h3]Our new visual novel, Holy Maid Academy, is coming in Q1 2024![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2680250/Holy_Maid_Academy/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43831064/d065bad59f0768a5efbd6c1c8dddf98a3e9a188b.png[/img]
[h3]Here's a short description of the game:[/h3]
Since its inception by the Nishiki family—a longstanding powerhouse in the local area—St. Martius Academy has served as a center of education for generations of maids.

When Ryunosuke Kokuto receives a personal invitation from the chairman of this respected edifice to serve as a professor, he doesn’t say no to the opportunity.

His mission? To teach his students to be the best darn maids ever to pick up a feather duster!

[h3]If you're interested, don't forget to wishlist the game on Steam to get notified upon release! Thank you for your support of Kuroinu Redux and Shiravune.[/h3]
